pr.title: Opt-in to `FulfillmentError` generation to avoid doing extra work in the new solver
pr.description:
In the new solver, we do additional trait solving in order to generate fulfillment errors, because all we have is the root obligation. This is problematic because there are many cases where we don't need the full error information, and instead are just calling `ObligationCtxt::select_all_or_error` to probe whether a predicate holds or not. This is also problematic because we use `ObligationCtxt`s within the error reporting machinery itself, and so we can definitely cause stack overflows:

https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/a94483a5f2bae907bc898fc7a8d9cc87db47b693/compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/inspect/analyse.rs#L75-L84

So instead, make `TraitEngine` and `ObligationCtxt` generic over `E: FulfillmentErrorLike<'tcx>`, and introduce a new `ScrubbedTraitError` which only stores whether the failure was due to a "true error" or an ambiguity. Then, introduce `ObligationCtxt::new_with_diagnostics` for the callsites that actually inspect their `FulfillmentError`s.

r? @lcnr

Number-wise, there are:
```
     39 ObligationCtxt::new
     32 ObligationCtxt::new_with_diagnostics
      1 ObligationCtxt::new_generic
```
calls to each `ObligationCtxt` constructor, which suggests that there are indeed a lot of callsites that don't care about diagnostics.

analysis.incorrectTransformation: Using the new default ScrubbedTraitError-producing ObligationCtxt::new at StateTransform's field-Sized check even though that callsite needs full FulfillmentError data for diagnostics. That reduction drops the per-obligation code/root obligation/span information needed by error reporting and is only safe for callsites that merely probe truth/ambiguity; the PR therefore deliberately opts this callsite in to new_with_diagnostics.
analysis.inputDomain: Rust programs containing coroutines/generators whose lowered coroutine layout has field types carrying Sized obligations, especially where at least one coroutine field type is not Sized or its Sized-ness is ambiguous so fulfillment errors are produced during StateTransform/coroutine layout checking. Compare only whether check_field_tys_sized receives full-diagnostic versus scrubbed fulfillment errors.
analysis.originalLogic: In the pre-change API, ObligationCtxt::new returned full FulfillmentError<'tcx> results. In StateTransform, check_field_tys_sized creates an inference context ignoring regions, creates an ObligationCtxt over the coroutine's param_env, registers a Sized bound for each coroutine_layout.field_tys element with an ObligationCause, and then uses the fulfillment engine to select/report errors. The PR explicitly changes this callsite to ObligationCtxt::new_with_diagnostics(&infcx), preserving full diagnostics when the default constructor is switched to scrubbed errors.
pitfalls: ScrubbedTraitError stores only TrueError/Ambiguity (later also Cycle), so it is insufficient for callsites that inspect obligation/code/root_obligation or call report_fulfillment_errors.
Ambiguity and Cycle are not hard true errors; is_true_error must distinguish them from Select/Project/Subtype/ConstEquate.

Opting in to diagnostics is a performance tradeoff: diagnostic generation does extra trait solving and can recurse or stack overflow when used inside error-reporting machinery, so only callsites that need detailed errors should use new_with_diagnostics.
The coroutine callsite was migrated in the same PR that introduced scrubbed defaults; do not assume the old ObligationCtxt::new semantics remain.
preconditions: StateTransform lowers a coroutine and calls check_field_tys_sized over coroutine_layout.field_tys.
The callsite registers Sized bounds and later consumes or reports fulfillment errors rather than only checking whether the predicate holds.
The new trait-solver diagnostics API is in use, or ObligationCtxt's default error type has been scrubbed.
analysis.summary: StateTransform's coroutine field-Sized check must opt into diagnostic-bearing fulfillment errors when the new solver's default ObligationCtxt is scrubbed. This keeps full FulfillmentError data available for reporting while allowing probe-only callsites to avoid extra trait solving and stack-overflow risk.
analysis.testStrategy: Compile coroutine/generator programs under the new solver where a coroutine field type fails or is ambiguous for Sized; verify the normal Sized/fulfillment diagnostic is emitted with the coroutine field's source span rather than an ICE or missing diagnostic. Use a control program where all coroutine field types are Sized and compilation succeeds. The historical patch contains no regression-test hunks, so this is a proposed focused test derived from the changed StateTransform callsite, not a reproduction.
analysis.trigger: Changing the new trait solver's ObligationCtxt/TraitEngine error type to a scrubbed error, or porting/reviewing StateTransform's check_field_tys_sized after ObligationCtxt::new stops producing full diagnostics by default.
